scope: Requirement-family handoff index, not exhaustive runtime action/state coverage. Test references are locations to reproduce, not a new test execution claim.

rows.requirement: Commercial stages, exact contract/invoice/cash and compensation history

rows.requirement: Scoped client/institution publication, imports and exports

rows.requirement: Explicit pending invitation and first password without MFA bypass
rows.limits: Owner privately completed setup/MFA and confirmed workspace entry. New/expired invitation and lost MFA recovery remain reviewed; no automatic customer linking.

rows.requirement: Separate existing-staff reset mail with one-use expiry, session revocation and retained MFA
rows.limits: Separate production sender/key configured; recipient confirmed real operator reset email. Latest private password change/signin not observed. Pending/suspended/unverified identities do not receive mail; audit trigger stores no secrets.

rows.requirement: Named existing-member directory and permission-scoped workspace controls

rows.requirement: Versioned progressive requirements, RFQ and gap checks
rows.limits: Preserve original requirement versions and response history; missing requirements are explicit.

rows.requirement: Original supplier offers, revisions/comparison and technical assessment

rows.requirement: Typed fair/factory/technical visits, machinery/site/after-sales requirements

rows.requirement: Versioned reviewed task rewards, reversals and contribution disputes

rows.requirement: Public discovery, progressive synthetic brief and customer access
